tools.name: search_notes

tools.name: get_note
tools.description: One published note in full (Markdown), with its numbered sources and links to the official record.

tools.name: list_ofac_actions
tools.description: OFAC's recent actions, newest first: designations and removals, general licenses, FAQs, regulations and settlements, each with its date, categories and the official page. Filter by date or words in the title.

tools.name: search_kev
tools.description: CISA's Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog, newest first: CVE, vendor, product, date added, federal due date, known ransomware use, the required action, FIRST's EPSS estimate, and whether it sits in the AI and agent software stack. tools.name: search_federal_register
tools.description: Search Federal Register rules, proposed rules, notices and presidential documents: title, type, agencies, publication and effective dates, citation, abstract and the official document link. tools.name: list_travel_advisories
tools.description: US State Department travel advisories, most recently updated first: country, level (1 to 4), the advisory's summary and the official page. Filter by country, minimum level or update date.

tools.name: get_reference_rates
tools.description: The New York Fed's reference rates: EFFR and OBFR (unsecured), SOFR, BGCR and TGCR (secured), and the SOFR averages and index (SOFRAI). With no rate, the latest of each; with a rate, its last N days, with percentiles, volume and, for EFFR, the target range.

tools.name: get_treasury_yields
tools.description: Treasury's daily par yield curve, newest first: yields by tenor from 1 month to 30 years. Ask for the last N days, and optionally only some tenors (for example ["2 Yr", "10 Yr"]).

tools.name: get_cve
tools.description: Everything the record says about one CVE, in one answer: the CVE.org record (description, severity, weakness, affected products, references), CISA's exploitation call (SSVC) and its KEV listing with the federal due date, FIRST's EPSS estimate, and whether it sits in the AI and agent software stack.

tools.name: list_cyber_advisories
tools.description: CISA's advisories, newest first: alerts, joint cybersecurity advisories (#StopRansomware, state-sponsored activity), ICS and ICS-medical advisories, and analysis reports. Each with its kind, date, summary, the CVEs it names and the official page. Filter by kind, date, words, or the AI stack.

tools.name: list_cyber_incident_filings
tools.description: Cybersecurity incidents public companies report on Form 8-K, newest first: Item 1.05 (the company judged it material) and, unless excluded, Item 8.01 reports made without that judgment. Each with the company, tickers, filing and event dates, items, state, industry code and the EDGAR filing.
